name: ibge-br-mcp-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker that serves ibge-br-mcp over Streamable HTTP (Fase 0 hosting template: createMcpHandler + UsageTracker)
//: @modelcontextprotocol/server and zod are intentionally NOT listed here — they resolve from the parent package's node_modules so there is a single SDK copy (avoids duplicate-instance type clashes with registerAll). `agents` declares them as hard peers, so .npmrc pins legacy-peer-deps=true to stop npm from installing a second copy here. If you extract this Worker to its own repo, add them as dependencies and depend on the published ibge-br-mcp package.
